reason: I drop every app after two weeks, so paying anything feels like buying something I'll stop opening. $4.99 isn't a lot, but I'd rather use the free version and see if it sticks.
objection: I'll probably stop using the app in two weeks, like every other one, so the money is wasted.
would_change_my_mind: If I was still opening it daily after week 3 and the lock-screen widget made starting tasks easier, I might buy the Start Kit for $1.99.
